evidenceLimits: Complete relevant families, not the complete dictionary. Omission does not prove absence. Selected senses are non-exhaustive and not independent level assignments. Mapping/source notes are author assertions to assess, not reviewer findings.

rows.mappingNote: Exact source spelling/reading and entry; filial piety or care for parents.
rows.sourceNote: Noun/suru/na uses taught. Parent-directed scope, not mere obedience or a universal prescription for family arrangements; broader devotion sense 2 is not selected.

rows.mappingNote: Exact source spelling/reading and entry; crossing or intersection.
rows.sourceNote: Intransitive suru frame explicit; 交叉 recognized without frequency inference. Raw cross does not license 道を交差する. 横断 also has a positively recorded intersecting use, so no universal exclusion is invented.

rows.mappingNote: Exact source spelling/reading and entry; speaker/lecturer and university lecturer/instructor.
rows.sourceNote: University lecturer does not mean professor or always part-time. School part-time teaching and cram-school tutoring are separately recorded additional teaching.

rows.mappingNote: Exact source spelling/reading and entry; construction work.
rows.sourceNote: Noun/suru; work may include repair/alteration rather than only erecting new buildings. Construction/work neighborhoods remain overlapping, not sealed categories.

rows.mappingNote: Exact source spelling/reading and entry; official/formal status and formula.
rows.sourceNote: Raw formality positively qualified through publicly established form/procedure, not arbitrary etiquette. Official no-modifier and mathematical noun uses are separate; social-media account sense 3 is not selected.

rows.mappingNote: Exact source spelling/reading and entry; excuse/pretext.
rows.sourceNote: Nを口実に construction; a convenient stated motive need not be a fabricated underlying circumstance. Not the standalone polite excuse-me expression.

rows.mappingNote: Source kana spelling/reading; thus/in this way.
rows.sourceNote: Primary kana-only metadata. Rare 斯うして recognized without a constituent card or invented frequency measurement. Demonstrated manner and outcome connection taught without an unrestricted equivalence to every so or directional this way.

rows.mappingNote: Exact source spelling/reading and entry; school building.
rows.sourceNote: Missing 舎 remains in written metadata. School institution/premises overlap acknowledged; unrelated 後者 preserved.

rows.mappingNote: Exact source spelling/reading and entry; the general public.
rows.sourceNote: Noun/no use; missing 衆 remains written metadata. Does not mean government ownership, free access or only an assembled performance audience.

rows.mappingNote: Exact source spelling/reading and entry; perfume/scent.
rows.sourceNote: Product-versus-smell distinction is a contextual teaching aid, not a claim of nonoverlapping ranges. Daijisen's separately read こうずい Buddhist water sense is not imported into こうすい.

rows.mappingNote: Exact source spelling/reading and entry; justice/fairness/impartiality.
rows.sourceNote: Noun/na adjective and に-adverb use; no categorical fairness-versus-equality split or claim that every factual correctness is impartial judgment.

rows.mappingNote: Exact source spelling/reading and entry; achievement, meritorious deed or distinguished contribution.
rows.sourceNote: Missing 功 remains written metadata. Accomplishment rather than effort alone; no required formal award. Broad contribution label does not equate achievement with monetary donation.

rows.mappingNote: Exact source spelling/reading and entry; ray/beam/light.
rows.sourceNote: 光's explicit ray/beam sense retained in comparison. Beam/structural 桁 safeguard is English-label safety rather than Japanese synonymy; light-weight 軽い remains disambiguated.

rows.mappingNote: Exact source spelling/reading and entry; source upper explicitly selected as high altitude/upper atmosphere.
rows.sourceNote: Bare upper does not establish the compiler's intent; selection is explicit. Building sense 1 is useful additional teaching, not independently assigned N2. Daijisen's reversed sense order is not confused with pinned JMdict indices.
rows.identityNote: Select JMdict sense 2 for the raw upper wording while preserving source fields; do not silently replace upper with only high-rise.

rows.mappingNote: Exact source spelling/reading and entry; structure/construction/makeup/framework.
rows.sourceNote: Raw construction is positively qualified as how parts are put together, rather than categorically wrong. Physical and abstract structures; no rigid partition from 構成/組織 or automatic decorative-pattern equivalence.

rows.mappingNote: Exact source spelling/reading and entry; alternation/change/replacement/shifts/taking turns.
rows.sourceNote: Source 交替 primary; 交代 alias explicitly taught. No absolute one-time/repeated spelling rule. Relief and rotation qualified by role change, not automatically reassurance, rescue or physical spinning. Obsolete こうだい not primary.

rows.mappingNote: Exact source spelling/reading and entry; arable land/farmland.
rows.sourceNote: Land for cultivation, not a requirement that it be tilled this instant. Separate Brazilian estate sense 2 is outside the selected teaching; no independent N2 assignment.

rows.mappingNote: Exact source spelling/reading and entry; transportation means/facilities/system.
rows.sourceNote: 交通 plus 機関 in its system/facilities sense, not traffic engine. Broad facility account does not categorically exclude infrastructure/communications or reduce every use to a single vehicle.

rows.mappingNote: Exact source spelling/reading and entry; source campus qualified as outdoor school grounds/schoolyard.
rows.sourceNote: Campus is a positively supported English gloss with outdoor-school qualification, not every campus building. 庭 need not be a planted garden. Unrelated 肯定 preserved.

rows.mappingNote: Reuse existing exact spelling/reading article; affirmation and logical affirmative already explicitly taught.
rows.sourceNote: Only sourced jlpt: 2 added; identity, primary reading, title, kanji array, exclusions and body preserved. Raw positive is interpreted as affirmative, not automatically optimism, mathematical positivity or proactive behavior. Existing 肯/肯定 reciprocal link retained.

reviewEvidence.provenance: 379 distinct complete comparison families and 143 actual existing labels/exclusions in two exact-form extractions. Both pinned JMdict gzip/XML hashes verified for each extraction. All 375 main compact families through EOF and all five supplemental families through EOF (36 lines) were inspected, including every sense, restriction, flag, inherited POS and homograph. Compact records omit only empty fields and abbreviate identical inherited POS as ditto. All 38 complete Japanese-reading/English-meaning component records and all actual labels/exclusions were read. Full existing-card bodies were captured; selected main bodies and all four supplemental bodies were read, not a complete 143-card rereview. Fifteen actual complete Daijisen lexical bodies were captured by a standard-library parser that associates lexical containers with publisher SGKDJ, after simplified extraction gave irrelevant material. Author-inspection receipts are not independent reviewer retrieval.

quizGuardRationale: Direct symmetric nontransitive safeguards address actual labels and ordinary secondary meanings, not unrestricted Japanese substitution. Shared topic, a component or homophony alone does not justify a pair. No existing exclusions change.
孝行 selects filial piety, not every enthusiastic/devoted activity. Its unrelated 高校 homophone is preserved without a safeguard based solely on sound.
交差 guards intersection and broad crossing answers. Positive 横断 intersecting sense is acknowledged; crossing movement does not license を交差する.
講師 guards actual teacher/instructor wording on 教師 and 先生; a lecture, lecture hall or professor's different academic rank is not automatically the same answer.
工事 guards construction/building and broad work labels, with repair/alteration in scope; not a sealed partition from 建設 or 建築.
公式 guards official/formal status, mathematical 式 and broad form/formality/conventional-formula labels on 形式 and 型. It does not teach every ceremony or shape as 公式.
口実 guards reason/explanation/excuse uses on 理由, 訳 and 申し訳. A spoken excuse-me formula and the verb apologize remain different constructions.

こうして guards demonstrative manner, thus/in-that-way and overlapping sequence/consequence wording, including ですから and すると directly. Directional this-way words are explicitly distinguished; no blanket interchangeability of all conjunctions.
校舎 guards actual school/building wording. 校庭 separately guards yard/campus/school-premises wording, not an identity between a building and its outdoor grounds.
公衆 guards public/society wording on 公共, 世間, 世の中 and 社会. Public use does not imply government ownership or a freely accessible facility.
香水 guards scent/fragrance answers while distinguishing a product from its smell without an absolute semantic wall.
公正 guards 公平, 平等 and ordinary just/proper 正しい. Fairness need not mean identical outcomes but does not exclude equal treatment.

功績 guards achievement/contribution, active contribution and broad assessed-results/outcome wording. 寄付's contribution label needs an English-label safeguard, not an assertion that a donation and distinguished service are unrestricted Japanese synonyms.

光線 guards physical light/ray/illumination wording, including source/light ambiguity on electric-light cards. 桁's bare beam is a label-only ambiguity, not a claim that a girder is a light ray. 軽い's explicitly weight-qualified title remains distinct.
高層 guards broad high/tall and upper-position wording; neither 高級's quality nor 上級's rank is automatically an atmospheric layer.
